biography: Keith Ashworth wasn't born into racing royalty. Hailing from a small village in the Cotswolds, his motorsport journey began not on a track, but on muddy country lanes, tinkering with his father's old Land Rover. That mechanical foundation, coupled with an insatiable desire for speed, led him to local karting events, where he quickly outshone the competition. A defining moment came at the age of 19 during a particularly wet race at Silverstone; battling against far more experienced drivers, Ashworth displayed preternatural car control to bring home a surprise victory. This triumph secured him a coveted spot in the Caterham Superlight series, where he has consistently impressed, carving a reputation for consistent performances and remarkable composure under pressure. Now at 33, Ashworth is at the peak of his abilities, a seasoned racer with his sights set on higher categories. He continues to impress the Caterham faithful, with many believing he has a bright future ahead of him.
drivingStyle: Ashworth's driving style is characterized by a meticulous and calculated approach. He's not one for flamboyant overtakes or daring dives; instead, he focuses on precision and consistency. He expertly manages his tires, preserving them for late-race surges. Ashworth's uncanny ability to read the track conditions allows him to find grip where others struggle. He's also renowned for his mental fortitude, rarely cracking under pressure, making him a formidable opponent in high-stakes races.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision in a championship-deciding race three seasons ago. Tensions remain high, both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A clash of driving styles. Dubois' aggressive, risk-taking approach contrasts sharply with Ashworth's calculated precision, leading to frequent on-track battles and heated post-race interviews.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A battle for consistent podium finishes. Both are known for their precision, with bragging rights at stake.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even if they're full of holes.
Listens to classical music precisely one hour before every race to calm his nerves.
Meticulously cleans his driving gloves before each session, regardless of their condition.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about taking risks, it's about minimizing them.
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham Superlight championship in 2020 after a season-long battle, clinching the title with a dominant performance in the final race.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure while leading the final lap of the Brands Hatch Grand Prix in 2018, costing him a well-deserved victory.
